title: Er-Chen decoction alleviates spermatogenic dysfunction in obese mice by tuning the SIRT1/p53 axis.
authors: Liu, Maohui; Chen, Jiawei; Zhou, Zubing; Wang, Jiexin; Li, Guangsen; Xie, Jinghui; Wen, Lingmiao; Wang, Huan; Gan, Rong; Zhang, Peihai; Gong, Yanju; Ding, Weijun
one_liner_zh: 研究中药二陈汤通过SIRT1/p53轴改善肥胖小鼠生精功能障碍，属于药理学与生殖医学研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Er-Chen Decoction (ECD), a classic traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formula, is clinically indicated for dispelling dampness and resolving phlegm. It has been widely used in the management of phlegm‒dampness syndrome, including obesity, with a long-standing clinical application history in improving obesity-related male infertility. Although its therapeutic efficacy has been validated through long-term clinical practice, the underlying molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. AIM: This study aimed to investigate the molecular mechanisms by which ECD ameliorates obesity-related spermatogenic dysfunction (SD) through the SIRT1/p53 signaling axis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A mouse model of diet-induced obesity was established by feeding a high-fat diet (HFD) for 8 weeks. Subsequently, obese mice were randomly assigned to receive interventions with ECD (low-, medium-, or high-dose) or L-carnitine (positive control) for 3 weeks. Sperm functional parameters were evaluated to assess obesity-related SD. A combination of network pharmacology analysis, molecular docking, biochemical assays, hematoxylin‒eosin (HE) staining, Oil Red O staining, transmission electron microscopy (TEM), quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT‒qPCR), immunofluorescence (IF) staining, immunohistochemical (IHC) staining, Western blotting (WB), and transcriptomic analysis was employed to dissect the molecular mechanisms underlying the protective effects of the ECD against obesity-related SD. Additionally, the bioactive components of ECD were characterized using extensive targeted mass spectrometry. RESULTS: Medium-dose ECD (ECD-M) significantly reduced body weight and lipid accumulation in HFD-induced obese mice. Notably, compared with the HFD group, the ECD-M group presented a 50 % reduction in the abnormal sperm percentage (p < 0.01), along with a 60 % increase in sperm concentration (p < 0.01), and showed an upward trend in both sperm progressive motility and sperm motility. Furthermore, ECD-M significantly upregulated the expression of the tight junction (TJ) proteins Occludin (p < 0.001) and beta-catenin (p < 0.05), thereby restoring the integrity of the blood‒testis barrier (BTB). Mechanistically, ECD not only reversed lipid-induced inhibition of SIRT1 but also suppressed p53 acetylation, leading to a significant decrease in the ratios of cleaved caspase-3/caspase-3 (p < 0.05) and Bax/Bcl-2 (p < 0.0001) in testicular tissues. These effects collectively alleviated mitochondria-mediated apoptosis in the testes of obese mice. CONCLUSION: ECD alleviates mitochondria-mediated apoptosis in testicular tissues by regulating the SIRT1/p53 axis, thereby mitigating obesity-related SD. These findings highlight ECD as a potential therapeutic agent for the management of obesity-related male infertility.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：二陈汤（ECD）是一种经典的中药方剂，临床上用于燥湿化痰，广泛用于治疗痰湿证（包括肥胖），并在改善肥胖相关男性不育方面具有悠久的临床应用历史。尽管其疗效已通过长期临床实践得到验证，但其潜在的分子机制尚未完全阐明。目的：本研究旨在探讨ECD通过SIRT1/p53信号轴改善肥胖相关精子发生功能障碍（SD）的分子机制。材料与方法：通过高脂饮食（HFD）喂养8周建立饮食诱导的肥胖小鼠模型。随后，将肥胖小鼠随机分配接受ECD（低、中、高剂量）或左卡尼汀（阳性对照）干预3周。评估精子功能参数以评价肥胖相关SD。采用网络药理学分析、分子对接、生化检测、苏木精-伊红（HE）染色、油红O染色、透射电子显微镜（TEM）、实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT‒qPCR）、免疫荧光（IF）染色、免疫组织化学（IHC）染色、蛋白质印迹（WB）和转录组学分析相结合的方法，解析ECD对肥胖相关SD保护作用的分子机制。此外，利用广泛靶向质谱法对ECD的生物活性成分进行了表征。结果：中剂量ECD（ECD-M）显著降低了HFD诱导的肥胖小鼠的体重和脂质积累。值得注意的是，与HFD组相比，ECD-M组的异常精子百分比降低了50%（p < 0.01），精子浓度增加了60%（p < 0.01），并且精子前向运动力和精子活力均呈上升趋势。此外，ECD-M显著上调了紧密连接（TJ）蛋白Occludin（p < 0.001）和β-catenin（p < 0.05）的表达，从而恢复了血-睾屏障（BTB）的完整性。在机制上，ECD不仅逆转了脂质诱导的SIRT1抑制，还抑制了p53乙酰化，导致睾丸组织中cleaved caspase-3/caspase-3（p < 0.05）和Bax/Bcl-2（p < 0.0001）的比值显著降低。这些效应共同减轻了肥胖小鼠睾丸中线粒体介导的凋亡。结论：ECD通过调节SIRT1/p53轴减轻睾丸组织中线粒体介导的凋亡，从而缓解肥胖相关SD。这些发现凸显了ECD作为治疗肥胖相关男性不育的潜在药物。
